parts.text: Discuss the key features of the scientific method in research.
Briefly discuss the motivation and importance of research.
Discuss the meaning and importance of research design.
Discuss the various sampling designs, indicating their advantages and disadvantages.
Distinguish between research methods and research methodology and explain the categories of research techniques.
Explain the contents of a research plan.
Explain the techniques of defining a research problem.
Discuss the design features of exploratory studies as distinguished from those of descriptive studies.
Explain the various methods of data collection in research.
